title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
layout_note: Three identical columns (time steps 1-3), each a real frame s_t at the bottom, an 'enc' trapezoid, and a latent z_t drawn as a cell grid; latents are chained left-to-right by arrows carrying the action a_t, and three prediction arrows fan up from each latent to a-hat, r-hat, q-hat.
grouping: No frames, panels or tints; the three time-step columns are separated only by spacing, and each latent sits in a light-grey rounded square tile.
shapes_depth: Flat with a single salmon-red hue family: encoders are filled salmon trapezoids with dark-red 'enc' text, latents are 5x5 grids of cells in white-to-red tints inside grey rounded tiles, arrows are thick salmon lines; observations are real rendered frames with a thin dark border.
proposed_highlight: No separate highlight; the latent z is drawn as a tinted cell grid rather than a box, which shows its structured (normalized) representation, and outputs are bold dark-red hatted symbols with no decoder back to pixels.
lesson: Use one hue family for the whole model and draw the latent state as a small tinted grid inside a tile, so a recurrent world model reads as three clean repeated columns with the outputs as coloured symbols on top.
notes: Venue from the first page ('Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024'). Observations are frames of a quadruped (dog) control task.

arrangement.units: three unframed time-step columns side by side on whitespace, linked at latent level
arrangement.inputs_as: real rendered frames s_1..s_3 of the agent, one per column, with bold math labels at their lower left
arrangement.losses_at: not drawn; predicted a-hat, r-hat, q-hat sit as bold red symbols at the tips of three arrows above each latent
arrangement.shared: the encoder is redrawn identically under each column (same trapezoid and label)

taxonomy.task: model-based continuous control with a decoder-free latent world model

insights.structure: Three identical columns (frame -> enc trapezoid -> latent tile) stand side by side, with the latent tiles linked horizontally into a chain at mid height.
insights.data: Observations are real frames, the latent is a 5x5 grid of red-tinted cells inside a grey rounded tile, and the outputs are only bold hatted symbols (a-hat, r-hat, q-hat) with no decoded images.
insights.emphasis: The whole drawing uses one salmon-red family, so nothing competes; the grid-textured latent and the absence of any decoder carry the message.
insights.flow: Each column reads bottom-to-top (frame to latent to three fanned outputs) while the chain reads left-to-right, with the action a_t curving in from above onto each horizontal transition arrow.
insights.avoid: The middle encoder's 'enc' label is a slightly different (magenta) colour from the other two without explanation, which reads as a stray difference.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
